title: で draws a boundary: みんなで and 世界で一番
summary: で marks the limit inside which an action or a state holds: a place, a group, a number, a region. It works with adjectives too.

blocks.text: Besides noun / verb / adjective, Japanese grammar sorts words into **static** words (体言: nouns and noun-like things) and **active** words (用言: verbs, adjectives and noun + copula). Active words **change shape** in their final kana and can modify. Static words never change, but they take **particles and the copula**. A noun plus だ or です becomes an active unit: 綺麗だ can become 綺麗だった or 綺麗で.
So the three possible engines (verb, adjective, noun + copula) are all active words.

**に** says where something goes or where it is. **へ** says its direction. **で** says the **boundary within which** an action or state takes place. Usually that is a place, but it need not be. Because で modifies active words, it works with verbs *and* with adjectives.

blocks.jp: この町で一番おいしいラーメン
blocks.en: The tastiest ramen in this town. (the boundary of the comparison)

blocks.jp: 世界で一番有名な歌手
blocks.en: The most famous singer in the world.

blocks.text: Numbers and groups are boundaries too

二人で踊る ("two of us dance"), 一人で行く ("go alone"), みんなで歌う ("we all sing"). The number or group is the limit of those who do it, just as a room is the limit of where. This is why one particle covers "where", "how many people" and "within what range".
で vs の with an adjective

世界の一番おいしいラーメン is possible: の links 世界 to the noun ラーメン, "the world's tastiest ramen". But in このラーメンは世界で一番おいしい you need で, because 世界 must modify the adjective おいしい, and の can only modify a noun that comes after it. (Modifiers always go before what they modify.)

items: Static words (nouns) take particles; active words (verb, adjective, noun + copula) change shape.
**で** marks the boundary of an action or state: place, group, number, range.
**の** modifies a noun; **で** modifies an active word.

options: The boundary within which something holds

questions.prompt: 日本＿＿一番高い山は富士山だ。
questions.note: で marks the range within which "highest" applies.

questions.prompt: 三人＿＿旅行した。 ((We) traveled, the three of us.)
questions.note: で marks the group within which the action happens.

options: このクラスで一番背が高い。
このクラスの一番背が高い。
このクラスを一番背が高い。
このクラスは一番背が高いで。
questions.note: で sets the boundary for the adjective phrase.

questions.note: It can modify an adjective engine or noun + copula.
